raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What does this PR do?

Enable cuDNN forward and backward normalization in the four DeepSeek-V3 performance recipes by setting `NVTE_NORM_FWD_USE_CUDNN=1` and `NVTE_NORM_BWD_USE_CUDNN=1` in each recipe's `cfg.env_vars`.

The first version of this PR set the flags in 20 recipes. E2E perf runs showed that cuDNN's norm kernels only help DeepSeek-V3, so the Qwen3-235B-A22B, Qwen3.5-VL and Nemotron-3 recipes keep TransformerEngine's native norm kernels.

## Changelog

- DeepSeek V3, 256 GPUs, GB200/GB300: BF16 and NVFP4 (four recipe functions, eight lines in two files).

## Results

E2E perf runs of all 20 originally targeted benchmarks with the flags, each compared with a run of the same benchmark from the same day without them. Norm-kernel time is the GPU time spent in TE or cuDNN normalization kernels per training iteration on rank 0, from per-kernel GPU profiles. "From norm kernels alone" is the change in norm time that doesn't overlap other GPU work, divided by the baseline iteration time.

| Model | Benchmarks | Step time vs same-day run | From norm kernels alone | Norm-kernel GPU time | In this PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | 4 | 2.3–4.6% faster | 2.2–4.4% faster | 52–54% less | Flags kept |
| Qwen3-235B-A22B | 6 | 0.8–4.2% slower | 1.7–5.1% slower | 2.6–3.3× more | Flags removed |
| Qwen3.5-VL | 4 | 1.4–4.4% slower | 1.1–2.5% slower | 2.6–3.1× more | Flags removed |
| Nemotron-3 Super, Ultra | 6 | −1.9% to +0.8% (see note) | within ±0.3% | +3.5 to +48.5 ms per iteration | Flags removed |

Nemotron-3: the measured range covers five benchmarks. Ultra GB300 measured +14.2%, which came from bursts of slow steps with the extra time in communication; its fastest steps matched the baseline and its norm kernels changed by 3.5 ms per iteration.

<details>
<summary>Per-benchmark numbers</summary>

| Benchmark | Step time, s (without → with flags) | Step time change | From norm kernels alone | Norm-kernel time, ms/iter (TE → cuDNN) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 GB200 · BF16, 256 GPUs | 19.121 → 18.640 | −2.5% | −2.2% | 590 → 274 |
| DeepSeek-V3 GB200 · NVFP4, 256 GPUs | 11.599 → 11.091 | −4.4% | −3.7% | 627 → 300 |
| DeepSeek-V3 GB300 · BF16, 256 GPUs | 16.314 → 15.945 | −2.3% | −2.3% | 541 → 257 |
| DeepSeek-V3 GB300 · NVFP4, 256 GPUs | 9.292 → 8.866 | −4.6% | −4.4% | 606 → 284 |
| Qwen3-235B-A22B GB200 · BF16, 256 GPUs | 24.447 → 24.633 | +0.8% | +1.7% | 749 → 2,076 |
| Qwen3-235B-A22B GB200 · MXFP8, 256 GPUs | 17.573 → 18.088 | +2.9% | +3.1% | 878 → 2,311 |
| Qwen3-235B-A22B GB200 · NVFP4, 256 GPUs | 15.831 → 16.195 | +2.3% | +3.9% | 856 → 2,389 |
| Qwen3-235B-A22B GB300 · BF16, 256 GPUs | 21.074 → 21.443 | +1.8% | +2.5% | 638 → 2,082 |
| Qwen3-235B-A22B GB300 · MXFP8, 256 GPUs | 14.217 → 14.810 | +4.2% | +5.1% | 872 → 2,638 |
| Qwen3-235B-A22B GB300 · NVFP4, 256 GPUs | 13.600 → 13.799 | +1.5% | +3.9% | 882 → 2,390 |
| Qwen3.5-VL 35B-A3B · GB300 · BF16, 8 GPUs | 10.071 → 10.258 | +1.9% | +2.3% | 295 → 876 |
| Qwen3.5-VL 35B-A3B · GB300 · MXFP8, 8 GPUs | 10.201 → 10.655 | +4.4% | +2.5% | 296 → 903 |
| Qwen3.5-VL 397B-A17B · GB300 · BF16, 64 GPUs | 11.452 → 11.612 | +1.4% | +1.1% | 247 → 631 |
| Qwen3.5-VL 397B-A17B · GB300 · MXFP8, 64 GPUs | 8.876 → 9.109 | +2.6% | +2.0% | 275 → 732 |
| Nemotron-3 Super GB200 · MXFP8, 64 GPUs | 7.422 → 7.282 | −1.9% | +0.3% | 66 → 114 |
| Nemotron-3 Super GB200 · NVFP4, 64 GPUs | 8.061 → 7.912 | −1.8% | −0.1% | 65 → 85 |
| Nemotron-3 Super GB300 · MXFP8, 64 GPUs | 5.369 → 5.414 | +0.8% | +0.2% | 77 → 121 |
| Nemotron-3 Super GB300 · NVFP4, 64 GPUs | 5.572 → 5.528 | −0.8% | 0.0% | 67 → 100 |
| Nemotron-3 Ultra GB200 · NVFP4, 256 GPUs | 2.552 → 2.556 | +0.2% | −0.1% | 27 → 34 |
| Nemotron-3 Ultra GB300 · NVFP4, 256 GPUs | 2.030 → 2.317 | +14.2% | −0.2% | 26 → 30 |

</details>

- The flags replace TE's `rmsnorm_*` kernels one for one with cuDNN's `ln_tma_fwd_kernel`, `ln_fwd_kernel`, `ln_tma_bwd_kernel` and `ln_bwd_finalize_kernel`, with identical launch counts per iteration.
- On DeepSeek-V3, cuDNN's forward kernels are 2.8–3.5× faster and its backward kernel about 3× faster. Only the dgamma finalize is slower, so total norm time roughly halves.
- On Qwen3-235B-A22B and Qwen3.5-VL, cuDNN's backward is 2.3–2.9× slower and its dgamma finalize 3.2–11× slower. The largest share is the per-head QK-norm RMSNorm, which normalizes rows of 128 channels on Qwen3 and 256 on Qwen3.5.
- On Nemotron-3, norm kernels take about 1–2% of an iteration, so the extra norm time does not measurably change step time.
- Against the 8–14 comparable runs without the flags per benchmark from 21 Oct to 1 Nov, the DeepSeek-V3 runs with the flags were faster than all of them. The Qwen runs were slower than all of them, apart from one outlier run on each Qwen3-235B GB300 benchmark.

Caveats: there is one run with the flags per benchmark. The baselines ran Megatron-Bridge main or r0.7.0 with Megatron-LM main or core_r0.20.0, so they are not same-stack A/B runs. Training configs and TransformerEngine Python sources were identical within each pair. Qwen3-235B loss matched the baselines within 0.02%. DeepSeek-V3 loss curves differ from the baselines, and these runs cannot separate that from the Megatron-LM changes.

## Validation

- All pre-commit hooks passed with `uv run --no-project --with pre-commit pre-commit run --all-files` and again on commit. This worktree's Megatron-LM submodule is not initialized, so pre-commit ran outside the project environment.
- The five reverted recipe files are byte-identical to the PR base `afcc7ee`. The remaining diff is the two flags in the four DeepSeek-V3 functions.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Throughput was validated with the E2E perf runs above, not locally.

## Before review

- [x] Read contributor guidelines; commits include DCO sign-off.
- [x] Evaluated tests: existing recipe-environment invariants cover paired flags; no new test needed for literal configuration additions.
- [x] Evaluated documentation: no public API or usage change requiring documentation.
- Optional dependency declarations are unchanged.

detail.title: perf(recipe): enable cuDNN normalization for DeepSeek-V3 E2E benchmarks

files.patch:
@@ -75,6 +75,8 @@ def deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_bf16_config() -> ConfigContainer:
         # Transformer Engine overlap settings for this model.
         "NVTE_BWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
         "NVTE_FWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
+        "NVTE_NORM_BWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
+        "NVTE_NORM_FWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
         # Keep DeepSeek kernel selection aligned with the measured baseline.
         "NVTE_ALLOW_NONDETERMINISTIC_ALGO": 0,
     }
@@ -223,6 +225,8 @@ def deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb200_nvfp4_config() -> ConfigContainer:
         # Transformer Engine overlap settings for this model.
         "NVTE_BWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
         "NVTE_FWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
+        "NVTE_NORM_BWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
+        "NVTE_NORM_FWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
         # Keep DeepSeek kernel selection aligned with the measured baseline.
         "NVTE_ALLOW_NONDETERMINISTIC_ALGO": 0,
         # NVFP4 fast-math path.

@@ -86,6 +86,8 @@ def deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb300_bf16_config() -> ConfigContainer:
         # Transformer Engine overlap settings for this model.
         "NVTE_BWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
         "NVTE_FWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
+        "NVTE_NORM_BWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
+        "NVTE_NORM_FWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
     }
     return cfg
 
@@ -332,6 +334,8 @@ def deepseek_v3_pretrain_256gpu_gb300_nvfp4_config() -> ConfigContainer:
         # Transformer Engine overlap settings for this model.
         "NVTE_BWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
         "NVTE_FWD_LAYERNORM_SM_MARGIN": 20,
+        "NVTE_NORM_BWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
+        "NVTE_NORM_FWD_USE_CUDNN": 1,
         # NVFP4 fast-math path.
         "NVTE_USE_FAST_MATH": 1,
         "NVTE_CUTEDSL_FUSED_GROUPED_MLP": 1,
